name: neural-seam
description: Adapter de host do Neural Seam para o Codex CLI: empacota as skills /ns-* de onboarding e loop de trabalho. Extensao explicita - nao imita o codex, nao empacota o binario Go e nao substitui `neural-seam login`/`connect`. Requer o binario `neural-seam` no PATH e um projeto conectado.
author: Neural Seam
